install_body:
First install
1. Extract this package to a temporary folder.
2. Double-click Install (macOS: Install.command; Linux: ./Install.sh; Windows: Install.bat) — a local install page opens in your browser.
3. Confirm the install folder, leave Smooth upgrade selected, click Install.
4. Then run Start from the install folder; set API keys under Model settings.
5. On a phone, open the PC LAN IP:PORT (or tunnel URL).

Upgrade
1. Stop Start in the old install.
2. Extract the new package, run Install, point at the existing folder.
3. Default is smooth (keeps data/ and .env); overwrite wipes data after confirm.

CLI (optional): ./Install.sh --cli  or  ./Install.sh --target ~/FawaiAvatar --mode smooth --yes
Language: FAWAI_LANG=zh-CN or --lang zh-CN
stop_hint: To stop: Ctrl+C in the Start terminal, or end the fawai-keeper process.
gui_hint: Pick a folder and mode, then Install. Default is smooth upgrade (keeps existing data).

gui_overwrite_confirm: Overwrite will delete data/ and .env in the target. Continue?
gui_waiting: Install page is open in your browser. Close that tab when done; Ctrl+C here to quit the installer.
gui_close_hint: After install, run Start from the install folder. You can close this page; Ctrl+C in the terminal stops the installer.

Mode:
  1 / smooth = smooth upgrade (default) — update program; keep data/ and .env
  2 / overwrite = overwrite — wipe target and reinstall (deletes data)
upgrade_overwrite_confirm: Overwrite deletes data/ and .env in the target. Type YES to confirm:

upgrade_same_dir: Target cannot be this extracted folder. Extract the new package elsewhere, then point target at your existing install.
